hook: Most dog owners don't know that some peanut butter can be toxic!
caption: Most dog owners don't know that some peanut butter can be toxic! Always check for xylitol before sharing. Have you checked your peanut butter? #PetSafety #XylitolDanger #DogCare #SouthAfricaPets #HealthyPets
